summary: The audit checks one introductory core course (HISTORY 115D, ENGLISH 131 or ENGLISH 184X) taken for 5 units, five more elective courses, every course letter graded, and the minor's 25 units in all. The electives are a coherent course of study the Undergraduate Faculty Director approves, so you move them in yourself; the listed electives are only suggestions. Checked by hand: each course is 3 units or more, and at most 5 units are in a medieval language. Courses may not also count toward another major or minor, and transfer or AP credit is not accepted.

emHIn0li.why: "This introductory course must be taken for five (5) units."

r1x0gXvF.why: Requirements Overview: "Students complete six courses of three units or more for a total of 25 units", so five electives beside the introductory course. "Electives may be selected from many offerings in various disciplines according to student interests, but they must follow a coherent course of study. The Undergraduate Faculty Director must approve this course of study and elective courses." Notes: "The pre-listed courses here are recommended electives but not required. Additional courses must be approved by the Faculty Director." So the student moves the five approved electives in; the 3-unit minimum for each and "Up to five units may be taken in a medieval language" are checked by hand.

replace.name: Five elective courses approved by the Faculty Director

program.why: Grading: "All courses must be taken for a letter grade."
